newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE coffee recovers from lows, ends touch firmer.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE coffee recovers from lows, ends touch firmer.

text.p: Robusta coffee futures perked up by the close on Thursday as New York arabicas moved a touch higher but volume and activity were thin and subdued, traders said.

Earlier, the London market took a backseat role waiting for a cue from New York, where speculators and funds with a large long position have been rolling over spot contracts before September's first notice day.
"They're just rolling over -- they don't want to be involved in any squeezes. September isn't going to be liquid after first notice day," said one.
London activity was quiet while arabicas prices declined to show any sharp movements, he said.

September robustas ended $5 higher at $1,515, recovering from a low of $1,485. November was up $4 at $1,530, keeping the nearby spread valued at discount with spot September weighed down by ample supply.
Volume totalled 4,589 lots, half of which was in the September contract.
